---
title: Compare profiles across several measures at once
description: A radar sets one polygon per group over spokes that share a scale, so a reader sees where profiles differ in shape.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Beta is steadier, Alpha is faster

These illustrative scores rate two teams on five skills. Each spoke is one skill on the same 0 to 100 scale, and each polygon joins one team's scores.

```chart
type: radar
title: Beta is steadier and cheaper, Alpha is faster
subtitle: Score per skill and team
data:
  inline:
    - {skill: Speed, team: Alpha, score: 80}
    - {skill: Reliability, team: Alpha, score: 65}
    - {skill: Cost, team: Alpha, score: 40}
    - {skill: Documentation, team: Alpha, score: 70}
    - {skill: Community support, team: Alpha, score: 55}
    - {skill: Speed, team: Beta, score: 50}
    - {skill: Reliability, team: Beta, score: 90}
    - {skill: Cost, team: Beta, score: 75}
    - {skill: Documentation, team: Beta, score: 45}
    - {skill: Community support, team: Beta, score: 85}
encoding: {x: skill, y: score, color: team}
axes:
  y: {label: Score}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each team's score on a skill.
